profile.plan: v1.12 plays the designer's baseline plus 4 adopted changes (power weight 1.01→1.26; Crypto target 11.67→12, crypto weight 2.04→2.34; disrupt weight 0.8→1.05; restore weight 1.3→1.69). Through Cycle 4: strong draw/Action Base cards and Crypto worth 2+ (never Shyte-Coin), aiming for ~12 Crypto per hand. Cycles 5-8: a balanced midgame of attacks, engine, Server Restore and VP. From Cycle 9: Chaos and Drain for the endgame push; VP cards from Cycle 9, and the last Draft buys only VP.
